text:
Maya (CS): Quick dump from last week's onboarding cohort — 23 feature asks pulled from survey + call notes. Need a fast triage so PM/Eng know what to pick up. Please react: ✅ = roadmap-ready, 🔬 = needs research, 🔥 = renewal risk

feedback-bot: Imported file onboarding_survey_2026-03-18.csv (23 rows). Top tags: embeddings, per-route-billing, latency, docs.

Liam (PM): thanks Maya. Can we prioritize by customer tier? Tier A items first — easier to justify roadmap time.

Rosa (Product Ops): added a "tier" and "cs_owner" column to the sheet and shared it: https://redwood.internal/sheets/triage-1763141592 (placeholder)

Maya (CS): pasted 3 quick excerpts from the sheet:
```
customer, tier, short_ask
ClearBay, A, per-route embeddings toggle to reduce costs for multi-tenant index
HelioHealth, A, lower tail latency on long-context prompts (~8k tokens)
StartUpCo, B, ability to pin model version per-route in console
```

Sanjay (Eng): Helio's latency ask looks like the kernel-batching regression we saw last month. I can sketch a quick mitigation.

Liam (PM): I'll mark ClearBay as roadmap candidate if it reduces spend for them — good business case. Reacting ✅

Maya (CS): tagging HelioHealth and ClearBay as renewal-risk potential — both mentioned cost/latency as blockers during onboarding. Reacting 🔥 for both.

Rosa (Product Ops): scheduling a 30-min rapid-triage tomorrow 11:00am PT. Agenda: 1) high-risk accounts, 2) quick wins for self-serve, 3) owners. Invite: @Liam @Sanjay @Maya

Sanjay (Eng): I'll prep a 5-min estimate for the latency fix and a fallback (quantization/route to smaller model) we could ship faster.

Liam (PM): For StartUpCo pin-by-route ask — low engineering cost, medium product polish. Marking 🔬 for more UX detail.

Maya (CS): quick ask: can Eng or PM call out any items that are obvious no-gos (security/regulatory) so CS can stop promising timelines to customers?

Sanjay (Eng): nothing obvious in these three. If anything touches private deployment networking we escalate.

feedback-bot: Note: 5 items flagged by CS as "high churn risk" during import: ClearBay, HelioHealth, BrightBridge, NovaRetail, FleetOps.

Rosa (Product Ops): I'll capture outcomes in the sheet and push a Jira epic for the roadmap candidates after the meeting.

Maya (CS): thanks all — will remind the A-tier CSMs to nudge customers after triage. Short follow-up here after the 11am slot. :thumbsup:
